title: Midnight expiry wave
story: 20,000 documents expire at midnight (valid-time boundaries) while morning traffic starts.
checked: Every affected subject is re-run at the boundary; reads before and after midnight are exact; live p99 holds.

witnesses.positive: subjects whose List A document ends at 2026-11-08T00:00Z (state at midnight differs from one ms before)
witnesses.negative: subjects whose document is valid for another year (same state on both sides)

domain: every expiring subject is re-run at the boundary and gains the re-verification obligation (O-DOMAIN)
faults: valid-time boundary crossing with no write at the boundary

oracle.source: O-REPLAY digests at validAt NOW, midnight minus 1 ms and midnight; O-DOMAIN for the re-run set
gaps: a re-run triggered by time alone needs the dependency index's next-boundary schedule (Triplex dependencyState.nextTemporalBoundary), not a feed entry
